evidence.observation: Tube pressure rising monotonically during growth from 2.94 to 3.22 Torr (k=20..25) while Ar setpoint and flow are constant at 100 sccm
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not from increased inflow
Exhaust O2 stays low (4-7 ppm), arguing against an air leak
Temperature holds 750 °C at setpoint with normal heater power, so no thermal fault

args.missing_evidence: Whether pressure continues to climb or plateaus; a brief Ar flow step-down test (pressure should drop proportionally if the pumping path is clear) would confirm downstream restriction versus gauge drift
